headline: CLE @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 4.73 at DET 3.21, with a projected total of 7.95. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CLE: CLE moved +0.07 runs while DET moved -1.48, changing the projected margin by +1.55 runs. The projected total fell -1.42, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +8.0%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Tanner Bibee has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Riley Greene, Travis Bazzana, Kevin McGonigle, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Gage Workman, Spencer Torkelson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
